title_zh: 全球健康与长寿每日简报
intro_zh: 每日汇总功能医学、长寿医学、精准营养、营养补剂与健康管理五大领域的中英文权威资讯，每条附原始出处链接。
intro_en: A daily digest of authoritative Chinese and international coverage across functional medicine, longevity medicine, precision nutrition, dietary supplements and health management — every item links to its original source.

items.title_zh: 停药数年仍留“菌群指纹”：2500余人研究揭示常用药物长期重塑肠道
items.title_en: Microbial fingerprints persist years after stopping common drugs, 2,500-person study finds
items.summary_zh: 爱沙尼亚塔尔图大学团队分析生物样本库2500余人的粪便与处方记录，发现抗抑郁药、β受体阻滞剂、质子泵抑制剂与苯二氮䓬类均与菌群改变相关，相当一部分在停药数年后仍可检出“微生物指纹”。同属苯二氮䓬的地西泮与阿普唑仑扰动强度并不相同，该类药物的影响量级可与广谱抗生素相比。研究者提醒，解读菌群数据必须纳入既往用药史。
items.summary_en: Researchers at the University of Tartu analysed stool samples and prescription histories from more than 2,500 Estonian Biobank participants. Antidepressants, beta-blockers, proton pump inhibitors and benzodiazepines were all linked to microbiome changes, and many left detectable microbial fingerprints years after patients stopped taking them. Diazepam and alprazolam, both benzodiazepines, differed in how strongly they disrupted bacteria, and the class as a whole rivaled broad-spectrum antibiotics. The team urges clinicians to factor past prescriptions into microbiome interpretation.

items.title_zh: 西北浆水里挖出“抗癌帮手”：GR-4益生菌与PD-1联用增效减毒
items.title_en: Probiotic from northwest China's fermented 'jiangshui' boosts PD-1 therapy in gastric cancer models
items.source_zh: 兰州晚报（新浪财经转载）
items.summary_zh: 兰州大学生命科学学院李祥锴团队联合兰大二院，从西北传统发酵食品“浆水”中分离出植物乳杆菌GR-4，在荷瘤小鼠中观察到：单用GR-4抑瘤有限，单用PD-1抑制剂虽抑瘤却明显掉体重，两者联用对肿瘤控制最佳且显著缓解消耗。成果发表于Frontiers in Immunology，首次证实该菌与PD-1的协同价值，但团队强调仍处基础研究阶段。
items.summary_en: A team led by Li Xiangkai at Lanzhou University, working with the university's second hospital, isolated Lactobacillus plantarum GR-4 from jiangshui, a traditional fermented food from northwest China. In tumour-bearing mice, GR-4 alone suppressed tumours only modestly, and PD-1 blockade alone shrank tumours but caused marked weight loss; the combination produced the best tumour control while easing wasting. Published in Frontiers in Immunology, the work is the first to show synergy between this strain and PD-1 inhibitors, though the team stresses it remains preclinical.

items.title_zh: 乙酸盐当“指挥官”：经FFAR2指令中性粒细胞分泌IL-22减轻结肠炎
items.title_en: Acetate directs neutrophils via FFAR2 to release IL-22 and dampen colitis
items.summary_zh: 坎皮纳斯州立大学与圣路易斯华盛顿大学团队在PNAS报告：膳食纤维发酵产生的乙酸，经中性粒细胞表面FFAR2受体指令其生产修复性细胞因子IL-22，从而缓解小鼠DSS结肠炎。反直觉的是，乙酸干预后结肠中性粒细胞数量不降反升；一旦清除中性粒细胞，乙酸的护肠作用完全消失。流式分析显示约20%的IL-22阳性细胞竟是中性粒细胞，且在ILC3缺陷小鼠中保护依旧。
items.summary_en: Teams at UNICAMP and Washington University in St. Louis reported in PNAS that acetate, produced when gut bacteria ferment dietary fibre, instructs neutrophils through the FFAR2 receptor to make the repair cytokine IL-22, easing DSS colitis in mice. Counter-intuitively, neutrophil numbers in the colon rose after acetate treatment; depleting neutrophils abolished all protection. Flow analysis showed about 20 percent of IL-22-positive cells were neutrophils, and protection persisted in mice lacking ILC3s, marking an independent, non-redundant role.

items.title_zh: 丁酸梭菌载双药：先护脑再护肠，同步缓解肠炎与焦虑抑郁
items.title_en: Dual-drug Clostridium butyricum delivery eases colitis and anxiety together in mice
items.summary_zh: 郑州大学王蕾团队构建序贯递送系统：以丁酸梭菌为底盘，表面载5-氨基水杨酸，外层裹含吲哚-3-乙酸（IAA）的肠溶聚合物。小肠pH升至5.5以上时外壳先溶，IAA入血靶向大脑、恢复海马α7nAChR与胆碱能抗炎通路；核心抵达结肠后再释放5-ASA。切断膈下迷走神经后IAA的护肠效应几乎消失，提示其经迷走神经远程调控肠道炎症。
items.summary_en: Wang Lei's group at Zhengzhou University built a sequential delivery system using Clostridium butyricum as the chassis, loaded on its surface with 5-aminosalicylic acid and wrapped in an enteric polymer containing indole-3-acetic acid (IAA). Above pH 5.5 in the small intestine the shell dissolves first, releasing IAA into the blood to act on the brain, restoring hippocampal alpha7nAChR and the cholinergic anti-inflammatory pathway; the core then reaches the colon and releases 5-ASA. Cutting the subdiaphragmatic vagus abolished IAA's gut protection, showing remote control via the nerve.

items.title_zh: 阿尔茨海默“清理系统”被找到缺口：CASS4基因失灵让斑块失控扩散
items.title_en: Alzheimer's cleanup flaw traced to CASS4 gene in microglia
items.summary_zh: 弗吉尼亚大学团队在Journal of Experimental Medicine报告，长期与阿尔茨海默病风险相关的CASS4基因主要作用于小胶质细胞而非神经元。基因功能受损时，小胶质细胞包裹、压实β淀粉样斑块的能力下降，斑块更快扩散，邻近神经元受损、认知恶化。研究者提出，CASS4活性缺陷或可作早期生物标志物，恢复其功能可能成为新治疗方向，但现有证据来自小鼠。
items.summary_en: Researchers at UVA Health reported in the Journal of Experimental Medicine that CASS4, a gene repeatedly linked to Alzheimer's risk, acts mainly in microglia rather than neurons. When the gene was disrupted in mice, microglia lost the ability to surround and compact amyloid-beta plaques, allowing them to spread faster, damaging nearby neurons and worsening cognition. The team suggests defective CASS4 activity could serve as an early biomarker and that boosting its function may offer a therapeutic route, though the evidence remains mouse-based.

items.title_zh: 一片降压药激活棕色脂肪：氯沙坦另辟代谢通路，10万人影像牵连情绪
items.title_en: Losartan switches on brown fat through a pathway separate from blood pressure
items.summary_zh: 洛克菲勒大学团队在Nature发表：常用降压药氯沙坦可在小鼠中激活棕色脂肪，提高耗氧与能量消耗而体重稳定，且激活通路与降压通路彼此独立，理论上可拆分开发。团队另分析逾10万名患者PET/CT，发现可检出棕色脂肪者血糖血脂、心功能与炎症指标更好，焦虑抑郁比例更低，但骨质疏松与部分皮肤病比例更高，SSRI则似抑制棕色脂肪。
items.summary_en: A Rockefeller University team reported in Nature that losartan, a widely used blood pressure drug, activates brown fat in mice, raising oxygen consumption and energy expenditure while body weight stayed stable. Crucially, the fat-activating pathway is distinct from the blood-pressure one, suggesting the effects could be separated in future drugs. Analysing PET/CT from over 100,000 patients, the team found those with detectable brown fat had better glycaemic, lipid, cardiac and inflammatory profiles and lower rates of anxiety and depression, but higher rates of osteoporosis and some skin conditions; SSRIs appeared to suppress brown fat.

items.title_zh: 45页综述拆解抗衰老药三派：清除、平抑、逆转各有各的坑
items.title_en: 45-page review sorts anti-aging drugs into clear, suppress and reverse camps
items.summary_zh: 一篇发表于Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy、45页548篇文献的综述把抗衰老干预分为三派：直接清除衰老细胞、抑制其SASP炎症分泌、把衰老细胞逆转回年轻状态。三者各有硬伤——清除易误伤正常细胞，平抑停药易反弹，逆转存在致瘤风险，作者主张以纳米递送精准投喂并联合用药。文中同时点出通讯作者与营养补充剂企业存在利益关联，尿石素A、麦角硫因等结论证据强度需打折。
items.summary_en: A 45-page review with 548 references in Signal Transduction and Targeted Therapy groups anti-aging interventions into three camps: clearing senescent cells outright, suppressing their inflammatory SASP secretion, and reprogramming them back toward youth. Each has a catch: clearance can hit healthy cells, suppression rebounds after stopping, and reprogramming carries tumorigenic risk, so the authors argue for nanoparticle-guided delivery and combination regimens. The piece also notes the corresponding authors' ties to supplement companies, cautioning that positive findings for urolithin A and ergothioneine rest on early-stage data.

items.title_zh: MIND饮食吃得越像，表观遗传时钟走得越慢：1740人队列证据
items.title_en: Closer MIND diet adherence linked to slower epigenetic aging in 1,740 adults
items.summary_zh: 一项发表于medRxiv的队列研究，把1740名美国“健康与退休研究”参与者2013年的膳食数据与2016年的DNA甲基化数据对接：MIND饮食依从性每提高1个标准差，PhenoAge加速衰老减少0.4年（95%CI −0.8至−0.1）、GrimAge减少0.3年，甲基化衰老“步速”亦下降，校正BMI与选择性加权后仍成立。属观察性关联，不能证明因果，也未发现特定亚群获益更多。
items.summary_en: A medRxiv cohort study linked 2013 dietary data to 2016 DNA methylation measures in 1,740 participants of the US Health and Retirement Study. Each one-standard-deviation higher MIND diet score was associated with 0.4 fewer years of PhenoAge acceleration (95% CI -0.8 to -0.1), 0.3 fewer years of GrimAge acceleration, and a slower methylation pace of aging, with associations persisting after BMI adjustment and selection weighting. The design is observational, so causality is unproven, and causal forests found no subgroup benefiting reproducibly more.

items.title_zh: 同样是20克蛋白，只有瘦猪肉碎让“双亮氨酸”飙起来
items.title_en: Same 20 g of protein, but only lean pork raised dileucine in a randomized trial
items.summary_zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校随机对照研究（Molecular Nutrition & Food Research）让健康年轻人在抗阻训练后分别摄入等蛋白（约20克）的低脂瘦猪肉碎、高脂猪肉碎、黑豆米饭、游离氨基酸饮料或纯碳水饮料。唯有瘦猪肉碎使血中双亮氨酸在90—120分钟显著高于基线，且其峰值与肌肉蛋白合成改善显著正相关，而游离亮氨酸未见此关联，提示食物基质改变吸收形态。
items.summary_en: A randomized crossover-style trial from the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, published in Molecular Nutrition & Food Research, gave healthy young adults one of five interventions after resistance exercise, each matched to about 20 g of protein: lean minced pork, high-fat pork, black beans with rice, a free amino acid beverage, or a carbohydrate-only drink. Only lean pork produced a significant rise in blood dileucine at 90 to 120 minutes, and dileucine peaks correlated with improved muscle protein synthesis, whereas free leucine did not, pointing to food matrix effects.

items.title_zh: 中国一年16.9万例癌症死亡与“吃”有关：红肉多、奶少、全谷物少排前三
items.title_en: Diet linked to 168,740 cancer deaths in China, with red meat, low dairy and low whole grains topping the list
items.source_zh: Public Health Nursing（赣南医科大学）
items.summary_zh: 赣南医科大学团队基于GBD 2023中国数据估算：2023年膳食危险因素归因癌症死亡168740例（95%UI 5.9万—31.4万），损失约409.6万DALY；年龄标化死亡率年均下降3.09%，但绝对负担因老龄化并未同步下降。危险因素前三位是红肉过多、奶类不足、全谷物不足，结直肠癌负担最重，男性与老年人更吃亏。属建模估算，区间很宽，不能推成个体风险。
items.summary_en: Using GBD 2023 estimates for China, a Gannan Medical University team calculated 168,740 cancer deaths attributable to dietary risk factors in 2023 (95% UI 58,920 to 314,397) and about 4.10 million DALYs lost. Age-standardised mortality fell 3.09 percent a year, yet absolute burden did not track it down because of population ageing. Excess red meat, insufficient dairy and insufficient whole grains ranked as the top three risks, colorectal cancer carried the largest burden, and men and older adults were hit harder. It is a modelled estimate with wide intervals, not individual risk.

items.title_zh: 抗炎饮食不靠“超级食物”：营养科主任给出四条原则
items.title_en: Anti-inflammatory eating is not about superfoods: a dietitian's four principles
items.summary_zh: 广东省人民医院临床营养科主任马文君指出，抗炎饮食要调控的是没有明显痛感的慢性低度炎症，而非感冒发烧、伤口红肿类急性炎症。她提出四条原则：食物多样化、优先新鲜天然食材、减少加工食品与快餐、保证足量蔬果；建议植物性食物约占全天三分之二，用全谷杂粮替换部分精白米面，规律摄入豆类与菌菇，并限制红肉、含糖饮料、油炸食品与酒精。
items.summary_en: Ma Wenjun, head of clinical nutrition at Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital, said anti-inflammatory eating targets chronic low-grade inflammation that produces no obvious pain, not the acute inflammation of a fever or a red wound. She set out four principles: eat a variety of foods, favour fresh whole ingredients, cut processed foods and fast food, and ensure ample vegetables and fruit. She suggested plant foods make up about two-thirds of daily intake, swapping some refined grains for whole grains and pseudo-cereals, eating legumes and mushrooms regularly, and limiting red meat, sugary drinks, fried food and alcohol.

items.title_zh: Nature：家用菌群检测火了，但“标准健康菌群”根本不存在
items.title_en: Nature: home microbiome tests are booming, but there is no standard healthy microbiome
items.summary_zh: Nature报道，面向消费者的肠道微生物组居家检测快速兴起，但采样方式、细胞破壁提取、参考数据库与菌种判定阈值各家不一，结果难以横向比较。更根本的问题是学界并不存在“标准健康菌群”基线，个体肠道生态差异极大；参照人群若选错，还会给出误导性建议。文章认为，仅出于好奇下单的消费者，把钱花在膳食纤维与多样化饮食上更实际。
items.summary_en: Nature reports that consumer home microbiome tests are proliferating, yet companies differ in sampling, lysis and extraction methods, reference databases and species-calling thresholds, making results hard to compare. More fundamentally, science has no standard healthy microbiome baseline: individual gut ecosystems vary enormously, and a poorly chosen reference population can yield misleading advice. For consumers buying a kit out of curiosity, the article suggests the money is better spent on dietary fibre and a more varied diet.

items.title_zh: “闪电入睡”的网红褪黑素：剂量超标两三倍，进口身份也是假的
items.title_en: Viral melatonin products found at two to three times the legal dose, with faked import status
items.summary_zh: 央视《财经调查》曝光：多款网红褪黑素以“进口普通食品”“膳食补充剂”类目上架，却在直播与短视频中宣称“闪电入睡”“改善睡眠”，实测含量超我国保健食品原料目录规定的成人每日1—3毫克两至三倍，部分还瞄准青少年，而目录明确将少年儿童列为不适宜人群。有厂商以7万—8万元打包海外商标、境外空转与报关，为超标产品伪造进口身份。
items.summary_en: CCTV's Finance Investigation found that several viral melatonin products are listed as imported ordinary foods or dietary supplements while being promoted in livestreams and short videos as fast-acting sleep aids. Testing showed melatonin at two to three times China's permitted adult dose of 1 to 3 mg per day, and some products target teenagers even though the ingredient catalogue lists children as unsuitable. Manufacturers reportedly charge 70,000 to 80,000 yuan to package overseas trademarks, offshore logistics loops and customs paperwork, faking an imported identity for over-dosed products.

items.title_zh: 保健食品家底摊开：注册1.4万个、备案2.7万个，前三功能占了一半
items.title_en: China's supplement registry: 14,000 approved, 27,000 filed, and half in just three claims
items.summary_zh: 国家食检中心审评员原黎兰在第23届中国国际保健博览会上披露：1996年至今累计注册保健食品1.4万余个，2017年5月至今备案2.7万余个，全国获生产许可企业1800余家。她同时点出三大短板——产品同质化突出，增强免疫力、缓解体力疲劳、辅助降血脂三项功能占批准产品一半以上；保健概念泛滥致消费者难辨识；跨境电商增长迅猛、消费需求外流。
items.summary_en: Speaking at the 23rd China International Health Industry Expo, reviewer Yuan Lilan of the National Center for Food Safety Risk Assessment's testing body said China has approved more than 14,000 registered health foods since 1996 and filed over 27,000 since May 2017, with more than 1,800 manufacturers holding production licences. She flagged three weaknesses: severe product homogenisation, with immune support, fatigue relief and lipid-lowering claims covering over half of approved products; rampant vague health concepts that confuse consumers; and rapid cross-border e-commerce growth that pulls demand offshore.

items.title_zh: 直播、私域、AI营销怎么管：多方共议食品保健食品宣传合规
items.title_en: Livestreams, private channels and AI marketing in the dock at food and supplement compliance forum
items.source_zh: 工人日报（新浪财经转载）
items.summary_zh: 中国市场监管报社主办的“坚守营销宣传底线”交流会在京举行，聚焦直播、私域、AI营销等新业态下食品与保健食品虚假夸大宣传治理。总局广告监管司、食品生产经营司、特殊食品司负责人分别就网络食品销售虚假宣传专项整治、食品安全主体责任落实、广告法规边界解读监管要求；地方局分享全链条风险分级与特殊食品抽检经验，呼吁政府、行业、企业、媒体协同共治。
items.summary_en: A forum hosted by the China Market Regulation News in Beijing examined how to curb false and exaggerated claims for foods and health foods across livestreaming, private traffic and AI-driven marketing, as part of the 2026 National Food Safety Awareness Week. Officials from the advertising, food production and special foods departments of the State Administration for Market Regulation outlined a special campaign against false online food claims, corporate responsibility requirements and the legal boundary for food and supplement advertising, while local regulators shared risk-tiered oversight and special-food sampling practices.

items.title_zh: 双十一保健品销售额同比增8%：年轻客群渗透加深，监管趋严利好头部
items.title_en: Supplements up 8% year on year over Double 11 as younger buyers pile in
items.summary_zh: 券商研报援引监测数据称，2026年双十一保健品销售额同比增长8%，年轻群体渗透率提升，叠加监管趋严，利好头部品牌集中度提升；同期量贩零食正从门店扩张转向规模与效率双驱动。研报把这两个细分列为具备产业趋势性机会的方向，并建议关注高ROE、高分红龙头。食品饮料板块三季报风险已集中释放，四季度起低基数效应逐步显现。
items.summary_en: A brokerage research note citing monitoring data said supplement sales grew 8 percent year on year during the 2026 Double 11 shopping festival, with younger consumers raising penetration, while tighter regulation favours consolidation among leading brands. Mass-market snack retail, meanwhile, is shifting from store expansion to scale-and-efficiency driven growth. The note lists both segments as offering structural trend opportunities and recommends high-ROE, high-dividend leaders, adding that risk in the food and beverage sector was largely released in third-quarter results.

items.title_zh: 糖尿病指南2026版：首提MLCK综合征，糖化≥7.5%可直接起始联合
items.title_en: China's 2026 diabetes guideline introduces MLCK syndrome and upfront combination therapy
items.summary_zh: 中华医学会糖尿病学分会大会公布《中国糖尿病防治指南（2026版）》要点：章节由20章扩充至27章，首次提出代谢—肝脏—心血管—肾脏（MLCK）综合征概念并建立0—4期分层监测；新增糖化血红蛋白≥7.5%或高于个体化目标1.5%的起始联合治疗路径；体重管理按减重5%、10%、15%分层，并把腰围、腰高比纳入目标；同时新增人工智能、干细胞治疗与肌少症管理。
items.summary_en: At the Chinese Diabetes Society congress, highlights of the 2026 China guideline for diabetes prevention and treatment were released. Chapters expanded from 20 to 27, and the guideline introduces the metabolic-liver-cardiovascular-kidney (MLCK) syndrome with a 0 to 4 staging and monitoring framework. A new upfront combination pathway applies when HbA1c is 7.5 percent or higher, or 1.5 percent above an individualised target. Weight goals are tiered at 5, 10 and 15 percent loss and now include waist circumference and waist-to-height ratio, alongside new sections on AI, stem cell therapy and sarcopenia.

items.title_zh: 老年友好社区长什么样：1400平方米嵌入式养老中心＋慢病智能监测
items.title_en: What an age-friendly community looks like: embedded care centres and smart chronic disease monitoring
items.summary_zh: 全国老龄工作会议提出建设老年友好社会后，央视走访浙江庆元、桐乡等地：庆元县同心社区通过加装坡道与栏杆完成公共区域适老化改造，建成1400平方米嵌入式居家养老中心，提供助餐、助浴、助医、助急服务，并为老人建立电子健康档案，开展慢病智能监测与家庭医生定期随访；桐乡则以“邻里小铺”推动低龄老人服务高龄老人。
items.summary_en: After the national conference on ageing called for building an age-friendly society, CCTV visited communities in Qingyuan and Tongxiang in Zhejiang. In Qingyuan's Tongxin community, ramps and handrails were added to public areas and a 1,400-square-metre embedded home-care centre now offers meals, bathing, medical help and emergency assistance. Residents have electronic health records, smart chronic disease monitoring and regular family doctor follow-ups. Tongxiang, meanwhile, uses neighbourhood shops to mobilise younger seniors to help older ones.

items.title_zh: 山区县怎么把家医签“实”：63支团队＋红黄绿三色管控入选全国18案例
items.title_en: Mountain county's family doctor model makes China's top 18 primary care cases
items.summary_zh: 2026年全国基层卫生高质量发展大会公布全国18个优秀创新案例，陕西山阳县《全人群全生命周期家庭医生签约健康管理》入选，是陕西唯一。该县以“1126”医共体为主线，组建63支复合型家医团队覆盖所有镇街，推行村医副院长与“县聘镇管村用”，对慢病实施红黄绿三色分级。目前县域就诊率94.69%、基层诊疗量占比65.5%以上、慢病规范管理率93.15%、满意度96%以上。
items.summary_en: At the 2026 national conference on high-quality primary health development, Shanyang county in Shaanxi was named among 18 outstanding innovation cases nationwide, the province's only entry, for its whole-population, whole-lifecycle family doctor contract model. Built around the county's 1126 medical community reform, it has formed 63 composite family doctor teams covering every township, introduced village-doctor deputy director roles and county-hired, township-managed staffing, and applies red-amber-green tiers for chronic disease. County-level visit rates now reach 94.69 percent, primary care accounts for over 65.5 percent of visits, standardised chronic disease management hits 93.15 percent and satisfaction exceeds 96 percent.

items.title_zh: 换医院不用重做检查：一座县级市上传660万份检验结果后的账本
items.title_en: One county city uploaded 6.6 million lab results so patients need not retest
items.summary_zh: 广东信宜市推进检查检验结果共享互认：市第二人民医院、怀乡中心卫生院接入省平台后累计上传检验结果660多万份、检查报告7万多份，医生调阅他院结果8000多次、互认5000多次，为患者节省约15.2万元。玉都街道社区卫生服务中心同步做实重点人群管理，截至11月19日高血压、糖尿病管理率均达100%，老年人管理率68%，0—6岁儿童86.19%。
items.summary_en: Xinyi in Guangdong is expanding mutual recognition of medical tests. After joining the provincial sharing platform, the city's second people's hospital and Huaixiang township health centre have uploaded more than 6.6 million lab results and over 70,000 imaging reports; doctors viewed other hospitals' results more than 8,000 times and accepted them over 5,000 times, saving patients about 152,000 yuan. Meanwhile Yudu subdistrict's community health centre reports 100 percent management rates for hypertension and diabetes as of 19 November, 68 percent for older adults and 86.19 percent for children aged 0 to 6.
